svg.title: Trapezoidal profile: speed up, cruise, slow down
svg.desc: Animated, two graphs drawn left to right together. Top: the setpoint speed over time ramps up at max acceleration, holds flat at max velocity, then ramps down at max acceleration: a trapezoid. Each phase is labeled as the cursor reaches it: speed up, cruise, slow down. Bottom: the setpoint position follows an S, curving up, rising straight while cruising, then curving flat at the end. An inset shows a short move, which never reaches cruise speed and makes a triangle instead. WPILib's TrapezoidProfile takes Constraints, max velocity and max acceleration, and gives the setpoint state at each time step; calculate each step from the previous setpoint, not the measurement, so the plan stays smooth.
svg.text: Trapezoidal profile: speed up, cruise, slow down
On a speed-time graph it's a trapezoid. Position follows an S.
WPILib's TrapezoidProfile takes Constraints (max velocity, max acceleration)
and gives the setpoint state at each time step. Calculate each step from
the previous setpoint, not the measurement, so the plan stays smooth.
